## Common WHERE Filters

### Partition Filters

```sql
-- Local date (most common partition filter)
WHERE local_date = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')

-- Rolling window (1d / 7d / 14d / 30d）
WHERE local_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 6) AND date('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')
WHERE local_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 13) AND date('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')
WHERE local_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 29) AND date('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')

-- Region (standard 8 regions)
WHERE grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
WHERE grass_region = UPPER('${grass_region}')

-- Combined partition filter
WHERE grass_region IN (${COUNTRIES})
  AND local_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 29) AND date('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')
```

### Entity Filters

```sql
-- Filter to valid entities
WHERE shop_id IS NOT NULL AND item_id IS NOT NULL

-- Filter to items in specific shops (semi-join)
AND shop_id IN (SELECT shop_id FROM candidate_list)

-- Filter to items with GMV
WHERE gmv_usd_1d > 0
WHERE gmv_1d > 0
```

### Scenario/Traffic Filters

```sql
-- Scene classification via business_line/module/object
CASE
  WHEN (business_line = 'Search' AND module = 'Global Search')
    OR (source1_business_line = 'Search' AND source1_module = 'Global Search')
    OR (source2_business_line = 'Search' AND source2_module = 'Global Search')
  THEN 'Search'
  WHEN (business_line = 'Homepage' AND module = 'Daily Discover')
    OR (source1_business_line = 'Homepage' AND source1_module = 'Daily Discover')
    OR (source2_business_line = 'Homepage' AND source2_module = 'Daily Discover')
  THEN 'DD'
  WHEN (business_line = 'Rcmd' AND object = 'you may also like')
    OR (source1_business_line = 'Rcmd' AND source1_object = 'you may also like')
    OR (source2_business_line = 'Rcmd' AND source2_object = 'you may also like')
  THEN 'YMAL'
  ELSE 'other'
END AS scene_type
```

### Campaign Day Exclusion

```sql
-- Exclude campaign days (day = month) and payday (15, 25)
WHERE MONTH(local_date) <> DAY(local_date)
  AND DAY(local_date) NOT IN (15, 25)
```

### Regional Date Filter

```sql
-- Filter by Singapore timezone date
WHERE regional_date = date('${1_DAYS_AGO}')
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### JOIN with ads_advertise_mkt_1d for ads performance + item attributes

```sql
-- Join on shop_id + item_id + grass_region (most common)
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_user_item_feature_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live metric
JOIN mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live adp
  ON metric.item_id = adp.item_id
 AND metric.shop_id = adp.shop_id
 AND metric.grass_region = adp.grass_region
 AND metric.local_date = adp.grass_date
WHERE adp.tz_type = 'local'
```

### JOIN with dws_advertise_performance_1d for ads metrics

```sql
-- Used to combine platform metrics with ads metrics
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dws_advertise_performance_1d__reg_s0_live perf
  ON metric.shop_id = perf.shop_id
 AND metric.item_id = perf.item_id
 AND metric.grass_region = perf.grass_region
```

### JOIN with dim_item__reg_s0_live for item attributes

```sql
-- Get item status, price, category
LEFT JOIN mp_item.dim_item__reg_s0_live item
  ON metric.item_id = item.item_id
 AND metric.grass_region = item.grass_region
 AND metric.local_date = item.grass_date
WHERE item.tz_type = 'local'
  AND item.status = 1  -- ITEM_NORMAL
```

### JOIN with dim_exchange_rate for currency conversion

```sql
-- Exchange rate for GMV conversion from local to USD
LEFT JOIN mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live exch
  ON metric.grass_region = exch.grass_region
 AND metric.local_date = exch.grass_date

-- Usage: broad_gmv_amt_local / exchange_rate
```

### JOIN with dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di for order attribution detail

```sql
-- Detailed order metrics with ATC proration
JOIN traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live order_detail
  ON order_detail.item_id = gmv_table.item_id
 AND order_detail.user_id = gmv_table.user_id
WHERE order_detail.grass_date BETWEEN date_sub('${date}', 14) AND date('${date}')
```

### LEFT JOIN for item GMV filtering

```sql
-- Check if item has GMV in a date range
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT grass_region, item_id, 1 AS has_gmv
  FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_user_item_feature_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live
  WHERE gmv_1d > 0
    AND local_date BETWEEN date('2026-04-16') AND date('2026-04-29')
) gmv_check
  ON base.grass_region = gmv_check.grass_region
 AND base.item_id = gmv_check.item_id
```

## Common Aggregations

### Rolling Window Aggregation (Most Common)

```sql
-- Sum over 7d/14d/30d rolling windows by shop_id, item_id
SELECT
    grass_region, shop_id, item_id
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN local_date = date('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}') THEN impr_cnt_1d END) AS imp_1d
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN local_date = date('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}') THEN click_cnt_1d END) AS click_1d
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN local_date = date('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}') THEN order_1d END) AS order_1d
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN local_date = date('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}') THEN gmv_usd_1d END) AS gmv_usd_1d
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN local_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 6) AND date('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')
          THEN impr_cnt_1d END) AS imp_7d
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN local_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 6) AND date('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')
          THEN click_cnt_1d END) AS click_7d
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN local_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 6) AND date('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')
          THEN order_1d END) AS order_7d
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN local_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 6) AND date('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')
          THEN gmv_usd_1d END) AS gmv_usd_7d
    ,SUM(COALESCE(impr_cnt_1d, 0)) AS imp_30d
    ,SUM(COALESCE(click_cnt_1d, 0)) AS click_30d
    ,SUM(COALESCE(order_1d, 0)) AS order_30d
    ,SUM(COALESCE(gmv_usd_1d, 0)) AS gmv_30d
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_user_item_feature_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE grass_region IN (${COUNTRIES})
  AND local_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 29) AND date('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')
  AND shop_id IS NOT NULL AND item_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
```

### Platform Metrics for Campaign Diagnosis

```sql
-- 1d/7d platform metrics at item level
SELECT
    shop_id, item_id
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN local_date = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}') THEN item_impr_cnt_1d ELSE 0 END) AS platform_impression_cnt_1d
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN local_date = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}') THEN item_click_cnt_1d ELSE 0 END) AS platform_click_cnt_1d
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN local_date = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}') THEN order_1d ELSE 0 END) AS platform_order_cnt_1d
    ,SUM(item_impr_cnt_1d) AS platform_impression_cnt_7d
    ,SUM(item_click_cnt_1d) AS platform_click_cnt_7d
    ,SUM(order_1d) AS platform_order_cnt_7d
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_user_item_feature_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE grass_region = UPPER('${grass_region}')
  AND local_date BETWEEN date_sub(date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'), 6) AND date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
GROUP BY shop_id, item_id
```

### Ads vs Organic Split

```sql
-- Ads/organic breakdown of traffic and orders
SELECT
    grass_region, shop_id, item_id
    ,SUM(COALESCE(item_impr_cnt_1d, 0.0))     AS platform_impression_cnt
    ,SUM(COALESCE(item_click_cnt_1d, 0.0))    AS platform_click_cnt
    ,SUM(COALESCE(atc_cnt_1d, 0.0))           AS platform_atc_cnt
    ,SUM(COALESCE(order_1d, 0.0))             AS platform_order_cnt
    ,SUM(COALESCE(gmv_1d, 0.0))               AS platform_gmv
    ,SUM(COALESCE(item_impr_ads_cnt_1d, 0.0)) AS ads_impression_cnt
    ,SUM(COALESCE(item_click_ads_cnt_1d, 0.0)) AS ads_click_cnt
    ,SUM(COALESCE(atc_ads_cnt_1d, 0.0))       AS ads_atc_cnt
    ,SUM(COALESCE(order_ads_1d, 0.0))         AS ads_order_cnt
    ,SUM(COALESCE(gmv_ads_1d, 0.0))           AS ads_gmv
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_user_item_feature_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE local_date BETWEEN date_sub('${date}', 15) AND date_sub('${date}', 2)
  AND grass_region IN ('BR')
  AND shop_id IN (SELECT shop_id FROM candidate_list)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
```

### Scene-Level Aggregation with Overall UNION ALL

```sql
-- Aggregate with scene_type dimension + overall
WITH omni_data AS (
    SELECT item_id, shop_id, grass_region, regional_date,
        CASE
            WHEN (business_line = 'Search' AND module = 'Global Search') THEN 'Search'
            WHEN (business_line = 'Homepage' AND module = 'Daily Discover') THEN 'DD'
            WHEN (business_line = 'Rcmd' AND object = 'you may also like') THEN 'YMAL'
            ELSE 'other'
        END AS scene_type,
        impr_ads_cnt_1d, impr_organic_cnt_1d, impr_cnt_1d,
        click_ads_cnt_1d, click_organic_cnt_1d, click_cnt_1d,
        order_ads_1d, order_organic_1d, order_1d,
        gmv_usd_ads_1d, gmv_usd_organic_1d, gmv_usd_1d
    FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_user_item_feature_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live
    WHERE regional_date = date('${1_DAYS_AGO}') AND item_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT item_id, shop_id, scene_type,
    SUM(impr_ads_cnt_1d) AS impr_ads_cnt_1d, SUM(impr_cnt_1d) AS impr_cnt_1d,
    SUM(click_ads_cnt_1d) AS click_ads_cnt_1d, SUM(click_cnt_1d) AS click_cnt_1d,
    SUM(order_ads_1d) AS order_ads_1d, SUM(order_1d) AS order_1d,
    SUM(gmv_usd_ads_1d) AS gmv_usd_ads_1d, SUM(gmv_usd_1d) AS gmv_usd_1d,
    grass_region, regional_date
FROM omni_data
GROUP BY item_id, shop_id, scene_type, grass_region, regional_date
UNION ALL
SELECT item_id, shop_id, 'overall' AS scene_type,
    SUM(impr_ads_cnt_1d) AS impr_ads_cnt_1d, SUM(impr_cnt_1d) AS impr_cnt_1d,
    SUM(click_ads_cnt_1d) AS click_ads_cnt_1d, SUM(click_cnt_1d) AS click_cnt_1d,
    SUM(order_ads_1d) AS order_ads_1d, SUM(order_1d) AS order_1d,
    SUM(gmv_usd_ads_1d) AS gmv_usd_ads_1d, SUM(gmv_usd_1d) AS gmv_usd_1d,
    grass_region, regional_date
FROM omni_data
GROUP BY item_id, shop_id, grass_region, regional_date
```

### Category-Level Price Bucket Aggregation

```sql
-- GMV per item with price bucket (AOV = gmv_usd_1d / item_sold_cnt)
SELECT grass_region, cate_level2_id,
    CASE
        WHEN gmv_usd_1d / item_sold_cnt < 0.1 THEN 0
        WHEN gmv_usd_1d / item_sold_cnt < 0.5 THEN 1
        WHEN gmv_usd_1d / item_sold_cnt < 1.0 THEN 2
        WHEN gmv_usd_1d / item_sold_cnt < 2.0 THEN 3
        WHEN gmv_usd_1d / item_sold_cnt < 3.0 THEN 4
        WHEN gmv_usd_1d / item_sold_cnt < 5.0 THEN 5
        WHEN gmv_usd_1d / item_sold_cnt < 10.0 THEN 6
        WHEN gmv_usd_1d / item_sold_cnt < 20 THEN 7
        WHEN gmv_usd_1d / item_sold_cnt < 50 THEN 8
        WHEN gmv_usd_1d >= 50 THEN 9
    END AS tag,
    SUM(order_cnt) AS order_cnt,
    ROUND(AVG(item_sold_cnt), 4) AS avg_sold_cnt
FROM (
    SELECT grass_region, local_date, user_id, item_id,
        SUM(order_1d) AS order_cnt,
        SUM(gmv_usd_1d) AS gmv_usd_1d
    FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_user_item_feature_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live
    WHERE gmv_usd_1d > 0
      AND local_date BETWEEN date_sub('${date}', 15) AND date('${date}')
      AND MONTH(local_date) <> DAY(local_date)
      AND DAY(local_date) NOT IN (15, 25)
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
) gmv_table
...
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
```

## Derived Metrics (Derived Metrics)

以下派生指标在 2+ 个代码文件中重复出现：

### Conversion Rate Metrics

```sql
-- CTR (Click-Through Rate)
platform_ctr = click_cnt / NULLIF(impr_cnt, 0)
ads_ctr = click_ads_cnt / NULLIF(impr_ads_cnt, 0)

-- CVR (Conversion Rate)
platform_cvr = order_cnt / NULLIF(click_cnt, 0)

-- CTCVR (Click-to-Conversion via Impression)
platform_ctcvr = order_cnt / NULLIF(impr_cnt, 0)

-- ATC Rate
platform_atc_rate = atc_cnt / NULLIF(click_cnt, 0)
```

### Unit Economics

```sql
-- AOV (Average Order Value)
platform_aov = SUM(gmv_usd_1d) / NULLIF(SUM(order_1d), 0)
ads_aov = SUM(gmv_usd_ads_1d) / NULLIF(SUM(order_ads_1d), 0)

-- CPA (Cost Per Acquisition) -- external table join required
cpa = expenditure_amt_usd / NULLIF(broad_order_cnt, 0)

-- ROI (Return on Ad Spend) -- external table join required
roi = broad_gmv_amt_usd / NULLIF(expenditure_amt_usd, 0)

-- CPM (Cost Per Mille) -- external table join required
cpm = expenditure_amt_local * 1000 / NULLIF(impression_cnt, 0)
```

### Average Daily Metrics

```sql
-- Daily average over N-day window
avg_daily_imp = SUM(COALESCE(impr_cnt_1d, 0)) / 7.0
avg_daily_order = SUM(COALESCE(order_1d, 0)) / 7.0
avg_daily_gmv = SUM(COALESCE(gmv_usd_1d, 0)) / 7.0
```

### Budget Usage Rate

```sql
-- Campaign budget usage (external table required)
budget_usage_rate = ads_expenditure_usd / NULLIF(budget_usd, 0)
```

### Snippet 3: Item GMV Check with dim_item

```sql
SELECT a.grass_region, a.grass_date, a.item_id, a.shop_id, MAX(b.has_gmv) AS has_gmv
FROM mp_item.dim_item__reg_s0_live a
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT grass_region, item_id, 1 AS has_gmv
    FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_user_item_feature_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live
    WHERE gmv_1d > 0
      AND local_date BETWEEN date('2026-04-16') AND date('2026-04-29')
) b ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region AND a.item_id = b.item_id
WHERE a.grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
  AND a.grass_date BETWEEN date('2026-04-23') AND date('2026-04-29')
  AND a.tz_type = 'local' AND a.status = 1 AND a.stock > 0
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
```

### Snippet 5: Label Generation -- Platform GMV for Item Selection

```sql

    SUM(gmv_usd_1d) / ${NUM_LABEL_DAY_AGG} AS label_platform_gmv
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_user_item_feature_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE grass_region IN (${COUNTRIES})
```
